source_families.scope: The listed API facts, not the entire library.

The caller constructs ZipInfo, then _decodeExtra may replace filename from CRC-matching version-1 0x7075 data. orig_filename stays the header-derived value; open compares the local header against that original.
Path transformations, supported Unicode-extra handling including malformed/empty extras, selected CRC checks, directory and legacy encoding cases were inspected. Upstream tests were not executed.
The requested release is retained; later current releases are not substituted. Independent commit API identifies the frozen pin as Python 3.13.9, and all three tag bodies match commit/cache hashes.
Unicode Path support is a real implemented capability. Historical issue title describes the earlier deficiency, not the frozen release behavior.
4.6.9 defines the UTF-8 path override, version and CRC of header-name bytes; UTF-8-flag decoding is not the only possible effective name mechanism.

Default case behavior, reserved characters/devices (including extensions and superscript COM/LPT digits), trailing dot/space, 8.3 aliases and namespace/path limits. Neither generic Unicode casefold nor source inspection proves every filesystem equivalence.

Directory moves are constrained to one drive. Copy/delete and replace flags have distinct behavior; this documentation does not establish the proposal's full crash, ACL or atomic-publication protocol.
